inputs.text: New York City’s sanctuary policies put ideology ahead of public safety: authorities released an illegal immigrant gang member despite the danger he posed, leaving ICE to make the arrest. When local officials weaken cooperation with federal immigration enforcement, the public bears the risk. A government’s first duty is to protect its citizens and uphold the law—not shield people with criminal records from accountability.
